title: research-notes@1
description: The research payload produced by contracts/research.md: the supported answer first, then the evidence behind it, any conditional recommendation, coverage, and open questions. `recommendation` is optional because the contract makes a recommendation conditional on the brief requesting one.

answer.description: Each requested subquestion's supported answer or its explicit unresolved status.

evidence.description: Load-bearing claims and their support: for external sources, the short quotation, provenance, `quoted` or `summary-derived` label, and what it supports; inferences linked to their premises; repository observations cited under evidence-rules.

recommendation.description: Present only when requested: the recommended approach with rationale, costs, uncertainties, and the design-search record (candidates weighed, the pick, why it won).

coverage.description: Named references inspected, searches performed, versions and dates covered, inaccessible or summary-derived material, and required work left unexamined.

open_questions.description: Open questions, material source disagreements, and gaps, with whether version, authority, or applicability resolves each disagreement.
